Instructions for Use
Device description: The Umbra Spinal System is a spinal fixation system. It is available in lengths from 15 mm to 28 mm.
Warnings: For single use only. Do not resterilize. Store at 15 °C to 30 °C.
Refer to the surgical technique guide for implantation instructions.

MR Safety
The Umbra Spinal System is MR Conditional. Scanning is possible under the conditions in the table below.
Static magnetic field strength: 1.5 Tesla and 3 Tesla only
Parameter 1.5 T 3 T
Maximum Spatial Field Gradient 2000 G/cm (20 T/m)
Maximum Gradient Slew Rate 200 T/m/s per axis
Operating Mode Normal Operating Mode
RF Coil Type head transmit/receive coil only
Whole-Body SAR ≤ 2 W/kg ≤ 1.5 W/kg
Maximum active scan time 10 minutes 20 minutes
MR image artifact: the artifact may extend up to 40 mm beyond the implant.
RF heating was evaluated using a body coil at 64 MHz and 128 MHz in a gel phantom.
Testing used a maximum gradient amplitude of 40 mT/m.
Wait at least 6 weeks after implantation before performing an MRI scan.
